description.content: The Amplify Platform API provides the interface to perform the following: - Manage account settings and credentials - Manage organization settings, users, service accounts, and teams - Retrieve organization usage data - Register and manage applications - Retrieve application metrics and analytics - Retrieve user, organization, and application activity See the Amplify Guide for documentation and examples on how to authorize API calls to platform services.
